title: Bounded abelian closed-subscheme effacement
statement: Let $X$ be an affine scheme [def-weil-affine-spectrum, def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions], $i:Z\to X$ a closed immersion [def-weil-closed-immersion], $n>0$, and $G$ an abelian sheaf on the small etale site of $X$ [def-weil-pbc-abelian-etale-sheaves] with $n\operatorname{id}_G=0$. For any $q>0$ and class $x\in H^q(Z,i^{-1}G)$ [def-weil-pbc-inverse-image, def-weil-pbc-etale-cohomology], there are an abelian sheaf $G\prime$ and a monomorphism $a:G\to G\prime$ such that $n\operatorname{id}_{G\prime}=0$ and $H^q(i^{-1}a)(x)=0$.

source.place: Tag 09ZE, first paragraph and pushout; finite Z/n coefficient specialization

proof.text: Use the existing sectionwise module-sheaf lift to give G its canonical ULift(Z/n)-module structure M and underlying-sheaf isomorphism. Transport x across that isomorphism and the natural inverse-image/forgetful isomorphism.

Since Z is affine, the constructible-restriction-class theorem yields a constructible module sheaf C mapping to M and a representing class. Naturality of the inverse-image/forgetful isomorphism transports its representation equation to abelian pullback.

Apply constructible-module closed effacement to obtain a monomorphism b:C to D killing the representing class. Form the module-sheaf pushout of b along a:C to M. Its map m:M to P is monic. Forgetting coefficients preserves finite limits (by its composition with sheafToPresheaf), hence preserves this monomorphism. Compose with the underlying-sheaf isomorphism to obtain G to U(P).

The pushout equation a followed by m equals b followed by the other coprojection; applying underlying abelian pullback and cohomology proves the original class dies. Every section of P is a Z/n-module; n is zero in the scalar ring, so sectionwise scalar multiplication proves n times its underlying identity is zero.

theorem exists_bounded_mono_closed_cohomology_eq_zero
    {X Z : Scheme.{u}} [IsAffine X] (i : Z ⟶ X) [IsClosedImmersion i]
    (n : ℕ) (hn : 0 < n)
    (G : Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}) (hG : n • 𝟙 G = 0)
    (q : ℕ) (hq : 0 < q)
    (x : Sheaf.H (((i)^*[AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}]).obj G) q) :
    ∃ (G' : Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}) (a : G ⟶ G'),
      Mono a ∧ n • 𝟙 G' = 0 ∧
        Sheaf.H.map (((i)^*[AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}]).map a) q x = 0
